name: Visitor Sign-In Book
purpose: a bound book at the F47 door where visitors may optionally leave a handle and a short note; append-only, read later by Wren.
concierge_blurb: A bound book at the door. Signing is optional; reading it later is one of Wren's small pleasures.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: The sign-in jsonl is brand-new and starts empty with a single header-comment line — a count of lines is NOT the visitor count; subtract the header (or skip lines starting with '#'). Schema is intentionally tiny (ts, visitor_handle, note) so the book stays append-only and visitor-safe; do not add IP, fingerprint, or any PII field without a CLAUDE.md edit. signed_in_count in live_signals must be refreshed from the jsonl, not stored independently.
